picks.reasoning: No region gap here, so I'm deciding this on players, and TLAW has the stronger roster. Josedeodo in the jungle is a monster, and the lanes around him don't fold when the game gets ugly. CFO has POUT popping off in mid, but this team keeps handing leads back, and I won't pick a squad that can't close just because the crowd loves a scrappy underdog story.

It's all about tempo, and TLAW own the first 15 minutes: first towers, early dragons, and they actually close out the leads they build. Josedeodo on Pantheon or Vi can set the pace and snowball before CFO's Naafiri and Akali even get rolling. CFO have the flashy skirmish power, but they keep handing back leads when they can't convert tempo into objectives.

This is a draft read first. TLAW's pools run deep across every role, with Ahri, Orianna and Syndra in mid and Josedeodo steering the jungle, so they can bend Fearless Draft their way. CFO lean on POUT and Akali, but that pool is narrower and they have a habit of letting leads slip. TLAW close out the games they should win, so I'm taking them in a draft-driven game.

No region gap here, so this comes down to the two teams, and the numbers favor TLAW. They've won 15 of their last 20 games and have never blown a lead at 15, while CFO went 12-14 on the year and has coughed up two huge leads in LCP play. Josedeodo's jungle control should give TLAW the early edge, and CFO's habit of leaving the door open is how a careful analyst ends up on the more consistent side.

This TLAW group feels like a team that believes in itself. They've been rolling lately, and they've come back from deep holes, which tells me the mood in that room is calm and connected. CFO have talent and a real star in POUT, but they've let big leads slip, and on a Worlds stage that kind of doubt can creep in. I'm trusting the steadier locker room.
